scoring_justification: The headline quantities are outputs of a full MD simulation workflow; the verifier cannot recompute them from raw trajectories, so it compares the agent's reported values against paper gold with appropriate tolerances and a trend check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported interaction energies (UFF ~1 kcal/mol, DREIDING ~0.5), adsorption densities (Tables 2,3), and self-diffusion coefficients (Table 4)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published values that a correct reproduction should approximately match.

required.adsorption_density_IRMOF1: object with keys "1wt%", "2wt%", "5wt%", "liquid", each containing {A: number, B: number, Total: number}
required.adsorption_density_IRMOF13: object with keys "1wt%", "2wt%", "5wt%", "liquid", each containing {A′: number, B′: number, C: number, E: number, Total: number}
required.self_diffusion_IRMOF10: object with keys "1wt%", "2wt%", "5wt%", "liquid", each a number (Å²/ps)
required.self_diffusion_IRMOF13: object with keys "1wt%", "2wt%", "5wt%", "liquid", each a number (Å²/ps)

outputs.description: Single JSON file containing all scored quantities: force‑field interaction energies, pore‑resolved adsorbed hydrogen densities, and H₂ self‑diffusion coefficients.

output_contract.notes: All adsorption densities are per available pore volume. The liquid‑density equivalent loading corresponds to filling every pore volume with 0.09 g/cm³ liquid hydrogen (1 H₂ per 47.48 Å³). D pore is excluded from analysis. Tolerances and relative ordering checks are defined in the hidden checker and are not part of the public contract.

steps.description: UFF and DREIDING interaction energies with ordering check
Adsorbed hydrogen density in IRMOF-1 A and B pores
Adsorbed hydrogen density in IRMOF-13 A′, B′, C, E pores
C pore densities must be higher than A′, B′, E
